visual_description: A small tripod-mounted device with a spinning anemometer (wind cups) on top and a digital rain gauge. A small solar panel on its neck powers its internal transmitter. It is placed on the highest ridge overlooking the dig site.

constraints.logic: Provides early warning for 'Phase 7: Site Closure' (Tarps & Sandbags).
constraints.background: Silhouetted against a dramatic, cloudy Montana sky.
